publisher: TheMoroccoAI.com (independent; not affiliated with the Government of Morocco)

classifications.VERIFIED FACT: An event, act or status that the cited source documents directly (for example, a signature, a launch or an appointment).
classifications.OFFICIAL TARGET: A quantified goal set by an official body. It is not an outcome and must not be read as achieved.
classifications.ANNOUNCED PLAN: A programme, institution or product an official body has announced or presented, whose operational delivery the registry has not verified.
classifications.INDEPENDENT ANALYSIS: An inference drawn by TheMoroccoAI from two or more records. It is labelled as interpretation, not as fact.
classifications.UNVERIFIED CLAIM: A statement attributed to a source whose underlying data the registry has not independently checked.

verification_statuses.verified: The source page was retrieved on the retrieval date and the excerpt was matched against it.
verification_statuses.partial: The source was retrieved but does not by itself carry every detail of the claim; the limitation is stated in verification_note.

records.title: Official launch of the national strategy "Maroc Digital 2030"
records.claim: The national strategy Digital Morocco 2030 (Maroc Digital 2030) was officially launched in Rabat on 25 September 2024 by the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform.
source_excerpts: La Stratégie nationale "Maroc Digital 2030" (Digital Morocco 2030) a été officiellement lancée, mercredi à Rabat
Cette stratégie, lancée par le ministère de la Transition numérique et de la Réforme de l'administration
records.verification_note: The dispatch is dated 25 September 2024 (a Wednesday), matching "mercredi".

records.title: Digital Morocco 2030: stated job and e-government objectives
records.claim: Digital Morocco 2030 sets the objectives of 240,000 direct jobs with a contribution to GDP in 2030, digitalising public services, and moving Morocco from 113th to 50th place worldwide in the e-government development index.
source_excerpts: la création de 240.000 emplois directs et la contribution au produit intérieur brut (PIB) en 2030
digitaliser les services publics. Le but étant de faire passer le Maroc de la 113e à la 50e place mondiale dans l'indice de développement du e-gouvernement
records.verification_note: The source does not give a separate target year for the e-government ranking objective; 2030 is the strategy horizon.

records.title: Head of Government statement on public digital investment, 2021–2024
records.source_organization: Maroc.ma (national portal of the Kingdom of Morocco)
records.claim: The Head of Government stated that public investment dedicated to digital technology rose from MAD 11 million in 2021 to more than MAD 1.7 billion in 2024.
source_excerpts: public investment dedicated to digital technology has recorded unprecedented growth, rising from MAD 11 million in 2021 to more than MAD 1.7 billion in 2024
records.verification_note: The statement itself is verified on the government portal. The underlying budget figures were not checked against finance-law documents, so the figures are recorded as an attributed claim.

records.title: Inaugural National AI Conference opens in Rabat
records.source_organization: Maroc.ma (national portal of the Kingdom of Morocco)
records.claim: The inaugural National AI Conference opened in Rabat on 1 July 2025, organised by the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform and structured around 13 thematic areas.
source_excerpts: The inaugural National AI Conference, held under the High Patronage of His Majesty King Mohammed VI, was launched on Tuesday in Rabat
Organized by the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform under the theme "An efficient and ethical AI strategy to serve our society,"
The conference is structured around 13 thematic areas
records.verification_note: Page dated Tuesday 1 July 2025. The ministry's synthesis report (MAI-EV-0005) gives the dates as 1 and 2 July 2025.

records.title: Synthesis report of the First National AI Conference: Al Jazari Institute memorandum (Nador)
records.source_organization: Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform
records.claim: At the First National AI Conference (Rabat, 1–2 July 2025), a memorandum of understanding for the creation of an Al Jazari Institute dedicated to AI research, training and innovation in the Province of Nador was co-signed by the Ministry of Digital Transition, also involving the Ministry of Higher Education, Scientific Research and Innovation and authorities of the Oriental Region.
source_excerpts: The First National Conference on Artificial Intelligence, held in Rabat on July 1st and 2nd, 2025

The creation of the Al Jazari Institute: A memorandum of understanding co-signed by the Ministry of Digital Transition, also involving the Ministry of Higher Education, Scientific Research, and Innovation.
This institute is dedicated to AI research, training, and innovation in the Province of Nador.
records.verification_note: Report section X, "Strategic conventions signed". The PDF's metadata gives a creation date of 3 September 2025; the month is taken from that and from the file path. Line-break hyphenation in the PDF was removed when quoting. The fact recorded is the signature of the memorandum; the institute's operational status is not verified.

records.title: Synthesis report: agreement on sovereign green data-centre infrastructure
records.source_organization: Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform
records.claim: Among the conventions signed at the First National AI Conference was an agreement with the Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development on establishing sustainable, high-performing and sovereign digital infrastructures (green data centres).
source_excerpts: the Minister Delegate for the Head of Government in Charge of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform officially signed several important agreements and memoranda during the event or at the closing ceremony.

The Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development: For the establishment and development of sustainable, high-performing, and sovereign digital infrastructures, in line with energy and climate challenges (Green Data Centers).
records.verification_note: The fact recorded is the signature of the agreement. No data centre built under it is documented in the registry.

records.title: Synthesis report: UM6P data-centre partnership convention
records.source_organization: Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform
records.claim: Among the conventions signed at the First National AI Conference was one with Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P) to formalise a strategic partnership on data centres and on collaboration in research, innovation, training and digital sovereignty.
source_excerpts: These conventions and memoranda of understanding were signed with:
UM6P aims to formalize a strategic partnership focused on data centers while promoting collaboration in research, innovation, training, and digital sovereignty.
records.verification_note: The fact recorded is the signature of the convention. Its stated purpose is quoted as written; delivery is not verified.

records.title: Signature of the constitutive convention of the public-interest group "Institut Jazari ROOT"
records.source_organization: CGEM (Confédération Générale des Entreprises du Maroc)
records.claim: On 12 January 2026, at the official launch of the "AI Made in Morocco" programme organised by the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform, the president of CGEM signed the constitutive convention of the public-interest group (GIP) "Institut Jazari ROOT" alongside several ministerial departments and public institutions.
source_excerpts: Casablanca, le 12 janvier 2026 - La Confédération Générale des Entreprises du Maroc (CGEM) a pris part à la cérémonie officielle de lancement du programme “AI Made in Morocco – L’IA au cœur de la transformation numérique et des services publics”, organisée par le Ministère de la Transition Numérique et de la Réforme de l’Administration.
a procédé à la signature de la convention constitutive du Groupement d’Intérêt Public (GIP) “Institut Jazari ROOT”, aux côtés de plusieurs départements ministériels et d’institutions publiques
records.verification_note: Source is a signatory's own publication. Publication of the approval decision in the Bulletin Officiel was not located during this sprint.

records.title: Convention signed in Fès creating the Al-Jazari Institute for Industry "JAZARI Industrie X.0"
records.source_organization: Maroc.ma (national portal of the Kingdom of Morocco)
records.claim: On 10 March 2026 in Fès, the Ministry of Industry and Commerce, the Ministry Delegate for Digital Transition and Administration Reform and the Ministry of Economy and Finance signed, with the four universities of the Fès-Meknès region, a convention creating the Al-Jazari Institute for Industry "JAZARI Industrie X.0", whose stated focus is AI, the Internet of Things, advanced robotics and industrial data analytics.
source_excerpts: Une convention a été signée, mardi 10 Mars à Fès, pour la création de l’Institut Al-Jazari pour l’Industrie "JAZARI Industrie X.0"

La convention a été signée par le ministère de l’Industrie et du Commerce, le ministère délégué chargé de la Transition numérique et de la Réforme de l’administration et le ministère de l’Economie et des Finances, d’une part, et les quatre université que compte la région Fès-Meknès. Il s’agit de l’Université Euro-Méditerranéenne de Fès, l’Université Sidi Mohammed Ben Abdellah de Fès, l’Université Moulay Ismail de Meknès et l’Université Al Akhawayn d’Ifrane
le développement de solutions innovantes reposant sur l’intelligence artificielle, l’Internet des objets, la robotique avancée et l’analyse des données industrielles
records.verification_note: The signature is the verified fact. The technology focus is quoted from the institute's stated ambitions ("ambitionne, selon les promoteurs") and describes intent, not delivered work.

records.title: JAZARI network announced across the twelve regions; JAZARI ROOT as its core
records.source_organization: Maroc.ma (national portal of the Kingdom of Morocco)
records.claim: In January 2026 the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform announced a network of "Jazari" institutes of excellence anchored in the twelve regions of the Kingdom, with JAZARI ROOT as its technical and strategic core, organised around e-government, smart rural and mountain zones, and major sporting events.
source_excerpts: l’ annonce, en janvier dernier, par le ministère de la transition numérique et de la réforme de l’administration de la mise en place du réseau des instituts "Jazari", une plateforme d’instituts d’excellence ancrés dans les douze régions du Royaume

Le noyau technique et stratégique de ce réseau repose sur l’institut "JAZARI ROOT" autour de trois thématiques clés, à savoir l’E-GOV, les smart zones rurales et montagneuses, ainsi que les grands événements sportifs.
records.verification_note: Coverage of all twelve regions is an announced design. The registry documents signed instruments for JAZARI ROOT (MAI-EV-0008) and JAZARI Industrie X.0 (MAI-EV-0009) only.

records.title: Morocco AI 2030 roadmap: 2030 targets
records.source_organization: Maroc.ma (national portal of the Kingdom of Morocco)
records.claim: The Morocco AI 2030 roadmap, presented by the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform, sets 2030 targets of MAD 100 billion in added value to GDP, 50,000 direct and indirect jobs, and 200,000 trained and certified AI talents.
source_excerpts: Morocco’s Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform on Tuesday in Rabat presented the main advances under the "Morocco AI 2030" roadmap

The roadmap, also referred to as “AI Made in Morocco,” aims by 2030 to generate 100 billion dirhams ($10 billion) in added value for the country’s GDP, create 50,000 direct and indirect jobs, and train and certify 200,000 AI talents
records.verification_note: These are targets. The source gives no progress figures towards them.

records.title: Morocco AI 2030 roadmap: pillars and the JAZARI Institutes network
records.source_organization: Maroc.ma (national portal of the Kingdom of Morocco)
records.claim: The Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform presented the Morocco AI 2030 roadmap in Rabat in September 2026. As presented, it is structured around three pillars (sovereignty and trust; innovation and competitiveness; impact, adoption and outreach) and relies on the national JAZARI Institutes network, described as comprising JAZARI ROOT, JAZARI Smart City, JAZARI EduTech and JAZARI Industrie X.0.
source_excerpts: Morocco’s Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform on Tuesday in Rabat presented the main advances under the "Morocco AI 2030" roadmap
The strategy is built around three pillars: sovereignty and trust, innovation and competitiveness, and impact, adoption and outreach.

Its implementation notably relies on the national network of JAZARI Institutes, the operational arm for AI research and innovation, comprising JAZARI ROOT, JAZARI Smart City, JAZARI EduTech and JAZARI Industrie X.0.
records.verification_note: The fact recorded is how the ministry described the roadmap's structure. The registry has no separate signed instrument for JAZARI Smart City or JAZARI EduTech.

records.title: Sovereign AI marketplace and the Idarati AI assistant presented
records.source_organization: Maroc.ma (national portal of the Kingdom of Morocco)
records.claim: The ministry unveiled a sovereign AI marketplace intended to give access to secure and trusted AI solutions hosted under Moroccan control, and presented Idarati AI, an agentic AI assistant intended to help users with administrative procedures.
source_excerpts: The ministry also unveiled a sovereign AI marketplace designed to provide access to secure and trusted AI solutions while ensuring data protection and maintaining control over infrastructure in Morocco.
One of the first solutions presented was Idarati AI, an agentic AI assistant intended to inform, guide and assist users with administrative procedures.
records.verification_note: The source documents a presentation. Public availability of the marketplace or of Idarati AI was not verified.

records.title: New government includes a Minister of Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation and Administration Reform
records.source_organization: Maroc.ma (national portal of the Kingdom of Morocco)
records.claim: The government appointed on 16 October 2026 includes a Minister of Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation and Administration Reform, and a Minister Delegate to that minister in charge of Administration Reform.
source_excerpts: chaired on Friday, 4 Jumada I 1448 AH, corresponding to October 16, 2026, at the Royal Palace in Rabat, the appointment ceremony of the members of the new government.
Ahmed Rahhou : Minister of Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation and Administration Reform.
Aïcha Guellaa : Minister Delegate to the Minister of Artificial Intelligence, Digital Transformation and Administration Reform, in charge of Administration Reform.
records.verification_note: The ministry's legal attributions, and whether it takes over the portfolio of the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform, were not yet published in a source retrieved by the registry.

records.title: AI Movement established as a UNESCO Category 2 Centre
records.claim: UNESCO reports that AI Movement was established as a Category 2 Centre under the auspices of UNESCO, following a tripartite agreement between UNESCO, the Government of Morocco and AI Movement.
source_excerpts: resulted in the establishment of AI Movement as a Category 2 Centre under the auspices of UNESCO
the official signing of the tripartite agreement between UNESCO, the Government of Morocco and AI Movement
records.verification_note: unesco.org serves a bot challenge to command-line clients, so the page was read through a web-fetch tool and the excerpts come from that rendering.

records.title: AI Movement: research centre created by UM6P in March 2021
records.claim: AI Movement, the International Center for Artificial Intelligence of Morocco, is a research and development centre created in March 2021 by Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P).
source_excerpts: Le Centre international d'intelligence artificielle du Maroc "AI Movement" est un centre de recherche et développement créé en mars 2021 par l'Université Mohammed VI Polytechnique (UM6P).

records.title: CNDP reference page for Law 09-08
records.source_organization: CNDP (Commission Nationale de contrôle de la protection des Données à caractère Personnel)
records.claim: The CNDP, Morocco's national commission for the control of personal data protection, publishes Law 09-08 as the reference legal text of its mandate.
source_excerpts: Loi 09-08 - Commission Nationale de Contrôle de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel
records.verification_note: Only the page title could be read; the body is rendered client-side. The law's promulgation and Bulletin Officiel references are not recorded because the official full-text hosts (sgg.gov.ma, adala.justice.gov.ma) were unreachable from the verification environment.

records.title: Synthesis report: conference outcomes as the foundation of a national AI roadmap
records.source_organization: Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform
records.claim: The ministry's synthesis report states that the First National AI Conference outlined and validated the strategic orientations forming the foundation of Morocco's future National AI roadmap, and frames the conference within the Digital Morocco 2030 strategy.
source_excerpts: the conference has outlined and validated the major strategic orientations forming the foundation of Morocco's future National Artificial Intelligence roadmap.
Driven by the ambitious Morocco Digital 2030 Strategy, the objective of the conference is to make Morocco a pioneer and a regional hub for AI
records.verification_note: The fact recorded is what the report states. The report does not use the name "Morocco AI 2030"; linking the two is an independent analysis recorded on the relationship.
